title: 第15章 阴宗传承第16章 修行境界
content_zh:
;;
玄阴真人对自己弟子的考校就这么以先抑后扬的方式结束了。
其实他的心里头还是很不是滋味的，这些天好不容易整理好该如何教导这个徒弟，结果没想到才放养了几天功夫。
这小子就直接铸就自己铸成剑道根基了！
先前以剑入道也就算了，毕竟境界还浅可以调整。
可是现在那阴阳参合的剑道如今看似浅显，但实则前途远大。
虽然表面上还是负阴生阳的路数，但实际上玄阴真人看得分明，这分明是一门从起步开始就阴阳相谐的神奇功法。
而其他，如同阴宗《玄阴气诀》便是初期阴强阳弱，要到大成时才能调和阴阳龙虎交泰。阳宗的《纯阳气诀》则是初期一味至阳至强，等到后期才能阳极生阴，而后慢慢阴阳交泰。
所以说，苏白尘这‘玄阴剑诀’在立意上竟比阴宗、阳宗的核心功法都还要高了半层。
而这一次考校之后，也让至少是玄阴真人名下的弟子们都认识到了一件事：这个少年是不一样的！
考校结束，接下来就是授艺时间，其实也是玄阴真人给自己的五个弟子答疑。
不过玄阴真人威势不小，除了枫林子以外其他三人都没办法很顺畅地表达自己的意思，也就只是简单提了两个问题便作数。
“罢了，你们在我这里不自在，就各自回去休息吧。”
“修行之事急不来，切忌再继续冒进了。”
三名亲传弟子纷纷抱拳行礼，然后准备告退。
就在这个时候，玄阴真人忽然道：“再过两个月，开阳宫主主持炼制的一炉‘回阳丹’火候就到了，届时我阴宗可以分得三枚……秋卓，莫要丧气，一枚‘回阳丹’就足以令你恢复旧伤了。”
张秋卓激动不已，回头就要再拜。
但玄阴真人一挥手就甩出一股阴柔劲气，将之给赶了出去。
房间里只剩下苏白尘和枫林子两个弟子了。
玄阴真人这才叹息着看向他们两人道：“他们三个虽然修炼用功，但终究难成大器。”

“枫林子，你是我一手带大的，将来我的衣钵也必有你继承，要继续努力莫要懈怠啊！”
这个时候玄阴真人对枫林子不再是那等严格至近乎苛刻的责骂了，反倒是语重心长，显得‘爱之深，责之切’。
随后玄阴真人又看向苏白尘道：“白尘，你年龄最小入门最晚，但你的心思和天赋都是最适合修炼的。”
“若要问谁最有可能将我阴宗传承发扬光大，你是不二之选。”
“你也要努力……虽然你的前途很远大，但是现在的情况……怕是没多少时间让你成长了。”
苏白尘颇为惊奇，这是出了什么大事？
枫林子也连忙询问：“师父，究竟是怎么了？”
玄阴真人叹道：“还不是妖魔又不老实了？”
“最近各地妖邪作祟的事情发生得越来越多了，更可恶的是那些魔道妖人也开始不老实。”
“多事之秋，或许你们以及他们三个要不了几年就要派出去除魔卫道了。”
枫林子惊讶道：“师弟师妹们的修为还浅，不过刚刚开始筑基而已，怎能外派历练？”
玄阴真人失笑：“只是这么一说罢了。”
“至少目前还轮不到你们这些小辈下场。”
content_en:
;;
Master Xuanyin's examination of his disciples ended in a way of suppressing first and then promoting.
In fact, he still felt very uncomfortable. He had finally figured out how to teach this apprentice these days, but he didn't expect that he had only been idle for a few days.
This kid has directly forged himself into the foundation of kendo!
It's okay to enter the Tao with a sword before. After all, the realm is still shallow and can be adjusted.
But now the yin and yang of swordsmanship seems simple now, but in fact it has a bright future.
Although on the surface it is still a way of negative yin to generate yang, in fact Master Xuanyin can clearly see that this is a magical skill in which yin and yang are in harmony from the beginning.
Others, like the Yin Sect's "Xuan Yin Qi Jue", are in which Yin is strong and Yang is weak in the early stage, and it is only when it is completed that Yin, Yang, Dragon and Tiger can be reconciled. The Yang Zong's "Pure Yang Qi Jue" focuses on maximizing Yang in the early stage, and then in the later stages, the Yang pole generates Yin, and then slowly the Yin and Yang balance.
Therefore, Su Baichen's 'Xuanyin Sword Technique' is half a level higher in intention than the core techniques of the Yin Sect and the Yang Sect.
After taking the exam this time, at least all the disciples under Xuanyin's name realized one thing: this boy is different!
After the school examination is over, it is time for teaching skills. In fact, Master Xuanyin answers questions for his five disciples.
However, Master Xuanyin was very powerful. Except for Feng Linzi, the other three people could not express themselves smoothly, so they simply asked two questions and then settled.
"That's all, if you don't feel comfortable here with me, just go back and rest."
“You can’t rush into cultivation matters, so don’t continue to rush forward.”
The three direct disciples clasped their fists and saluted, and then prepared to leave.
At this time, Master Xuanyin suddenly said: "In two months' time, the furnace of 'Huiyang Pill' refined by the master of Kaiyang Palace will be ready. By then, our Yin Sect can get three pills... Qiuzhuo, don't be discouraged, one 'Huiyang Pill' is enough to restore your old injuries."
Zhang Qiuzhuo was so excited that he turned around and bowed again.
But Master Xuanyin waved his hand and threw out a wave of feminine energy, driving him away.
There were only two disciples left in the room, Su Baichen and Feng Linzi.
Master Xuanyin sighed and looked at the two of them and said, "Although the three of them practice hard, they will never become great."
"Feng Linzi, I brought you up, and you will inherit my mantle in the future. Keep working hard and don't slack off!"
At this time, Master Xuanyin no longer scolded Feng Linzi in such a strict and almost harsh way. Instead, he spoke with sincerity and sincerity, showing that he "loves deeply and blames deeply".
Then Master Xuanyin looked at Su Baichen and said, "Baichen, you are the youngest and the latest to get started, but your mind and talent are the most suitable for cultivation."
"If you want to ask who is most likely to carry forward our Yin Sect inheritance, you are the best choice."
"You also have to work hard...although you have a bright future, but the current situation...I'm afraid there won't be much time for you to grow."
Su Baichen was quite surprised. What big thing happened?
Feng Linzi also quickly asked: "Master, what happened?"
Master Xuanyin sighed: "Isn't it a demon and dishonest?"
"Recently, there have been more and more evil incidents happening in various places. What's even more disgusting is that those evil spirits have also begun to be dishonest."
"In such troubled times, maybe you and the three of them will send out demon-killing guardians in a few years."
Feng Linzi said in surprise: "The cultivation level of the junior brothers and sisters is still shallow, but they have just begun to build the foundation. How can they be sent out to practice?"
Master Xuanyin laughed: "That's all."
"At least it's not your juniors' turn to end up here yet."
